recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-39162 unless a future work-group decision changes the Device.name.display approach or the later FHIR-43164 type-binding decision.
issue_request: FHIR-39162 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification R5 resolution to remove Device.displayName and clarify/rework the Device name backbone so a display/preferred name is indicated through Device.name.display with a uniqueness rule.
initial_application: Commit 37fccabd56 reworked Device.deviceName into Device.name, renamed the child name to value, added Device.name.display, and updated name/type/value descriptions. The Jira-linked commit e646b7459 enabled the dev-1 invariant, and later QA commits 55512f8e09 and 49dbfef931 moved/normalized it to the current root expression name.where(display=true).count() <= 1.
additional_context: OO minutes on 2022-11-28 and 2022-12-05 confirm the intended solution. Device is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-43164 later intentionally changed Device.name.type from the R5 required code binding to extensible CodeableConcept with jurisdictional guidance, and FHIR-46397 later removed stale Device.displayName comments while keeping the intentional release note that the element was removed.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source has Device.name, Device.name.value, Device.name.type, Device.name.display, and the dev-1 condition, and it has no active Device.displayName element; the remaining displayName mention is an intentional release/ballot note explaining removal.
